name: Aikawa
source:
Aikawa is a young adult who is hardly younger or older than [url=/c82647]Yuuma[/url] who hangs around her house. She seems to have a connection with [url=/c77587]Eve[/url] and her work as a maid but we don't really know. 

[spoiler]Aikawa is the scientist who created Eve, she considers herself as Eve's mother and even wrote her name in her family notebook.[/spoiler]
